name: aal-plugins
description: Alternative Asset Literacy: MCP plugins for individual investors and for financial advisors covering alternative-asset education, including private equity and venture capital, tokenized real-world assets, gender-lens investing, art, DeFi and climate investing, with retirement and illiquidity calculators and a lookup of public SEC and FINRA registration records.

plugins.name: aal-retail-mcp
plugins.description: Alternative-asset education for individual investors: a 351-term glossary, learning modules, deep-dive tracks, a retirement Monte Carlo estimator, an illiquidity-pacing model, a directory of advisor-search networks and firms that state a focus on women clients, and a lookup of public SEC and FINRA records. Free previews; full content with a subscription.

plugins.name: alternative-asset-literacy-advisor
plugins.description: Per-seat client-education toolkit for financial advisors: nine deep-dive tracks, a compliance check for draft client communications, a retirement Monte Carlo estimator, and an illiquidity commitment-pacing model. The glossary, a module preview, a meeting icebreaker, a client gift bundle and a SEC/FINRA registration lookup work without a seat.
